steps.title: Prepare AcX stock solution
steps.instruction: Dilute 5 mg AcX in 500 µL anhydrous DMSO (10 mg/mL), aliquot, store at –20 °C; before use dilute 20 µL aliquot in 2 mL PBS.

steps.title: Fix cultured cells on coverslips
steps.instruction: Place cells on 18 mm coverslips (coated as desired). Add pre‑warmed fixative (4 % PFA, or 4 % PFA + 0.1 % GA, or –20 °C MeOH, or extraction per Damstra et al.) and incubate 10 min at 37 °C. Wash twice with PBS.

steps.title: Permeabilize cultured cells (if needed)
steps.instruction: Incubate 10 min with 0.1 % Triton X‑100 in PBS at room temperature, then wash three times with PBS.

steps.title: Block and immunostain cultured cells
steps.instruction: Block with 3 % BSA in PBS for 1 h at RT. Incubate primary antibodies in 3 % BSA/PBS for 1–3 h at RT or overnight at 4 °C. Wash three times with PBS. Incubate secondary antibodies in 3 % BSA/PBS for 1–3 h at RT or overnight at 4 °C. Wash three times with PBS.

steps.title: Anchor cultured cells with AcX
steps.instruction: Incubate cells in 0.1 mg/mL AcX in PBS overnight at RT, or 0.2 mg/mL for 1 h at RT (use stock from Step 1).

steps.title: Assemble gelation chamber for cells
steps.instruction: Place a parafilm‑covered glass slide, attach a silicone ring (13 mm diameter) with binder clips, and keep the chamber on ice.

steps.title: Prepare monomer solution (cells)
steps.instruction: Mix gelation‑solution components without APS, TEMED, or 4HT (see Recipe “Gelation solution”). Keep on ice; aliquot optional, store at –20 °C, thaw fully at RT before use.

steps.title: Add initiators and load gelation solution
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL TEMED (10 % stock) and 15 µL APS (10 % stock) to the monomer solution, vortex, keep on ice. Pipette 170 µL onto the parafilm, tap the coverslip side on tissue to remove excess PBS, place the cell‑side down onto the monomer solution, and close the chamber.

steps.title: Polymerize gel on cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the assembled chamber to a 37 °C incubator and polymerize for 1 h.

steps.title: Digest or disrupt gel (cells)
steps.instruction: Gently remove the gel into a 12‑well plate. For enzymatic digestion add 2 mL digestion buffer (see Recipe) and incubate 4 h at 37 °C (optional DAPI may be added). For non‑proteolytic disruption incubate 3 h in 5 % SDS, 200 mM NaCl, 50 mM Tris pH 7.5 at 80 °C, or use a hybrid proteolytic‑non‑proteolytic approach.

steps.title: Optional protein staining (cells)
steps.instruction: After digestion wash gel twice 15 min with PBS, incubate with 20 µg/mL fluorescent NHS‑ester or maleimide for 1.5 h at RT, then continue with digestion. If a disruption or hybrid step was used, add the stain after that step.

steps.title: Expand gel (cells)
steps.instruction: Transfer gel to a 15 cm dish, fill completely with Milli‑Q water. Exchange water at least twice after 30 min, then leave overnight at RT to expand.

steps.title: Perfuse and post‑fix mouse brain
steps.instruction: Transcardially perfuse mice with ice‑cold 4 % formaldehyde in 100 mM sodium phosphate buffer, pH 7.4. Dissect brains, post‑fix in 4 % formaldehyde for 2 h to overnight at 4 °C, then wash with PBS.

steps.title: Slice and wash tissue
steps.instruction: Vibratome‑slice brain at 100–300 µm thickness. Wash slices twice with PBS.

steps.title: Permeabilize tissue (if needed)
steps.instruction: Incubate slices 30 min with 0.1 % Triton X‑100 in PBS at RT, then wash three times with PBS.

steps.title: Block and immunostain tissue
steps.instruction: Block in 2 % BSA, 0.1 % Triton X‑100 in PBS at RT for 30 min–2 h. Incubate primary antibodies in the same buffer at RT for several hours to several days. Wash four times 30 min with blocking buffer. Incubate secondary antibodies in blocking buffer at RT for several hours to several days. Wash three times 30 min with blocking buffer, then once with PBS.

steps.title: Anchor tissue with AcX
steps.instruction: Treat slices with 0.1 mg/mL AcX in PBS overnight or 0.2 mg/mL for 1 h (stock from Step 1). Wash with PBS.

steps.title: Assemble gelation chamber for tissue
steps.instruction: Place four dabs of vacuum grease on a glass slide at the corners of an 18 mm coverslip. Keep the slide on ice.

steps.title: Prepare gelation solution with 4HT (tissue)
steps.instruction: Mix 2.7 mL 4 M sodium acrylate, 3.6 mL 5.6 M acrylamide, 0.025 mL 2 % bis, 1.0 mL 10× PBS, 2.225 mL Milli‑Q water, 0.15 mL TEMED (10 % stock), 0.15 mL APS (10 % stock), and 0.15 mL 0.1 % 4HT (final 0.0015 % 4HT). Keep on ice and vortex.

steps.title: Gel polymerize tissue sample
steps.instruction: On ice add the gelation solution to the tissue slice and incubate 20 min while shaking. Remove excess solution, place the slice on the grease dabs, cover with a coverslip, press gently until contact is made, and pipette away excess gelation solution ensuring the specimen stays ≥ 3 mm from air or grease. Transfer the chamber to a 37 °C incubator for 1 h.

steps.title: Digest or disrupt gel (tissue)
steps.instruction: Tease the coverslip off with a razor blade and tweezers, trim gel close to the specimen, wash once in PBS for 5 min. Digest with proteinase K using the digestion buffer (see Recipe) as for cells, then wash PBS four times 30 min each. To increase protein retention, reduce AcX and proteinase K concentrations ~10‑fold and follow with high‑temperature SDS disruption: incubate gel in excess disruption buffer (5 % SDS, 200 mM NaCl, 50 mM Tris pH 7.5) for 3 h at 80 °C. If cracks appear, increase proteinase K concentration or incubation time, or raise temperature to 90 °C. The original ExM method (proteinase K diluted 1:100 in guanidine‑containing buffer) may also be used for more aggressive digestion.

steps.title: Optional protein staining (tissue)
steps.instruction: Incubate gel with NHS‑ester dye (e.g., Atto594 or Alexa488) at 20 µg/mL in 1× PBS for 1 h at RT.

steps.title: Expand gel (tissue)
steps.instruction: Transfer gel to a 6‑well plate or 15 cm dish, wash with water for 30 min at least three times, then leave overnight at RT to expand. Keep the dish covered to protect the gel from CO₂‑induced acidification.

steps.title: Prepare gelation solution recipe
steps.instruction: Combine 271 µL 4 M sodium acrylate, 360 µL 5.6 M acrylamide, 2.5 µL 2 % bis, 100 µL 10× PBS, 236.5 µL Milli‑Q water, 15 µL TEMED (10 % stock), and 15 µL APS (10 % stock) to obtain final concentrations of 1.1 M sodium acrylate, 2 M acrylamide, 0.005 % bis, and 1× PBS.

steps.title: Prepare digestion buffer recipe
steps.instruction: Per gel, mix 1,550 µL 1× TAE buffer, 100 µL 10 % Triton X‑100 in PBS, 320 µL 5 M guanidine HCl, and 30 µL proteinase K (600 U/mL).

steps.title: Prepare disruption buffer recipe
steps.instruction: Mix 10 mL 10 % SDS, 1 mL 1 M Tris pH 7.5, 0.8 mL 5 M NaCl, and 8.2 mL Milli‑Q water to obtain 5 % SDS, 0.05 M Tris, and 0.2 M NaCl.
